title: Galar Fossil Egg Groups
description: A datapack for Cobblemon that adds egg groups to the Galar fossils for breeding
body:
Updates the Galar fossils as follows:
- Arctovish is in "Water 2" and "Monster"
- Arctozolt is in "Water 2" and "Dragon"
- Dracovish is in "Amorphous" and "Monster"
- Dracozolt is in "Monster" and "Dragon"

As of Cobblemon 1.7.X, this also requires [Cobbreeding](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbreeding)
